# Suite releases

<!-- Generated by `scripts/release-status.mjs` from each app's `package.json` and the date
     in its changelog. Do not edit the table; edit those files and regenerate. -->

The signed Flatpak remote is the update path. This page is the human mirror of the
[rolling Suite Desk + Suite Go 2026-11-27 release](https://github.com/mrrnbhd/suite-apps/releases/tag/suite-2026.11.27), which is the repository's
"Latest" release on GitHub. Only the two superapps have a release page; a pack carries
a signed version.

## Install

The signed Flatpak remote is where the desktop apps come from. Add it once, before any
`flatpak install` line below works:

```sh
flatpak remote-add --user --if-not-exists --from suite https://flatpak.suite.run/suite.flatpakrepo
```

Remote: [suite.flatpakrepo](https://flatpak.suite.run/suite.flatpakrepo)

## Channels and maturity

A channel is a promise about a build: `slop`, `nightly`, `preview` or `stable`. Channels are on
the superapp, Suite Desk and Suite Go, not on individual mini-apps. Packs carry signed versions,
not channels. Maturity is separate: `pre-alpha`, `alpha`, `beta` or `1.0`, so a `stable`-channel
build can still be `alpha`.

| Channel | Suite Desk | Suite Go | Page |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `slop` | `flatpak install --user suite run.suite.slop.desk//slop` | `suite-go-slop-<version>.apk` on that page | `suite-slop-<date>-<revision>` |
| `nightly` | `flatpak install --user suite run.suite.nightly.desk//nightly` | `suite-go-nightly-<version>.apk` on that page | `suite-nightly-<date>` |
| `preview` | `flatpak install --user suite run.suite.preview.desk//preview` | `suite-go-preview-<version>.apk` on that page | `suite-preview-<date>` |
| `stable` | `flatpak install --user suite run.suite.desk` | [`suite-go.apk`](https://github.com/mrrnbhd/suite-apps/releases/latest/download/suite-go.apk) | `suite-<date>` |

## Mobile

| App | Channel | Maturity | Version | Install |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| [Suite Go](https://github.com/mrrnbhd/suite-apps/blob/main/hosts/go/CHANGELOG.md) | stable | pre-alpha | 0.3.0 | [suite-go-0.3.0.apk](https://github.com/mrrnbhd/suite-apps/releases/download/suite-2026.11.27/suite-go-0.3.0.apk) |

Suite Go is not a Flatpak. This release carries its release-signed APK, [suite-go-0.3.0.apk](https://github.com/mrrnbhd/suite-apps/releases/download/suite-2026.11.27/suite-go-0.3.0.apk),
with a SHA-256 checksum beside it; sideload it with `adb install -r -t`.

## Update

Once the remote is added, the desktop apps update with:

```sh
flatpak update --user
```

GitHub Packages is not used for the Flatpaks.

## Regenerate
